pages.text: This is the GUI of the Shop block

1: Buy/Sell toggle. Click to change between buy and sell mode.$(br)2: Search box. Type an item name to search for it, if the shop is too large. (you can also scroll up/down)$(br)3: Account Balance.$(br)4: Buy/Sell area. Click to buy or sell the item. Press Shift to buy more at once, and Control for even more (up to a full stack).
